column1: # Objects the install's operators and add-ons leave behind, outside Argo CD's inventory
# and outside the namespaces the uninstall deletes. Found by scanning site-b and proto-hub
# after the first real uninstall (2026-11-10); uninstall.sh deletes them last, before the
#   KIND      resource, as oc names it
#   NAMESPACE a namespace, or - for cluster-scoped
#   TARGET    a name; label:SELECTOR; prefix:TEXT (names starting with TEXT); or all
#   FLAGS     - ; strip (drop finalizers first: their controller is already gone); or
#             managed-by:MANAGER (only if MANAGER wrote it: leaves a platform's own copy)
# Protected namespaces are never touched, whatever this file says. A prefix must not match
# the admin/edit/view/crdview roles OLM generates for each CRD ("KIND.GROUP-VERSION-..."):
# the CRDs stay, and so do those roles.
